description: This file defines a static diagnostic class for detecting property usage in RPC interfaces within the Orleans code generator. It sets up a diagnostic rule and provides a method to generate diagnostics when an RPC interface contains properties, which is disallowed.

classes.name: RpcInterfacePropertyDiagnostic
classes.description: A static class that defines diagnostic rules and methods for detecting properties in RPC interfaces in the Orleans code generator.

methods.name: CreateDiagnostic
methods.description: Creates a diagnostic record indicating an interface contains a property, used to enforce the rule that RPC interfaces must not include properties.
